results.title: General Manager – Land Transportation
results.description: Our client, a growing land transportation company based in Najran, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven General Manager to lead the business through its next stage of growth. The role requires a business builder with a strong track record of growing and scaling transportation or logistics businesses. The successful candidate will have full responsibility for the company's strategic, commercial, operational, and financial performance, with a strong mandate to accelerate business development, market penetration, expansion, and modernization . Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a multi-year growth and expansion strategy to significantly strengthen the company's market position. Drive business development and market penetration through new customers, contracts, sectors, services, and strategic partnerships. Identify and evaluate opportunities for geographic expansion, service diversification, and fleet investment. Take full ownership of the company's P&L, revenue growth, profitability, cash flow, and overall business performance. Lead large-scale transportation and fleet operations, ensuring strong asset utilization, productivity, service reliability, and cost efficiency. Optimize fleet performance, maintenance, fuel consumption, route planning, capacity utilization, and operational KPIs. Lead commercial negotiations, contract pricing, customer management, and strategic account development. Drive the company's digitalization and modernization agenda , leveraging technology, data, automation, and modern transport/fleet management systems. Build scalable organizational structures, processes, systems, and capabilities to support rapid business growth. Build and develop a strong leadership team and establish a performance-driven, accountable organizational culture. Maintain strong relationships with customers, strategic partners, government entities, and other key stakeholders. Ensure appropriate governance, safety, risk management, and regulatory compliance as the organization expands. Candidate Profile Minimum 12 years of relevant experience , including at least 5 years in a senior leadership capacity . Strong background within land transportation, logistics, fleet management, or a closely related sector . Proven track record of growing, scaling, or significantly expanding a business , with tangible achievements in revenue growth, market penetration, new customer acquisition, or business expansion. Strong business development and commercial orientation combined with solid transportation and fleet operational expertise. Demonstrated P&L ownership and strong understanding of profitability, cost structures, investment decisions, and asset utilization. Experience leading sizeable operational workforces and multidisciplinary teams. Exposure to digital transformation, fleet technology, automation, or transportation management systems is highly desirable. Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and highly results-oriented leadership style. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, Logistics, or a related discipline; an MBA is preferred. Interested candidates with a demonstrated record of building and scaling transportation businesses are invited to apply or share their profile for confidential consideration.

results.title: Last Mile Operations Manager
results.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
results.description: We operate autonomous delivery vehicles in the UAE. This role owns whether those deliveries actually land — on time, without failure, without a complaint. Once a customer is live and vehicles are on the road, the fulfilment flow is yours: order intake, dispatch, pickup, driving, customer handover. You will take it apart, make it measurable, watch it in real time, and drive the fixes. You will lead a team of 2–3. Expect to firefight. Early-stage operations break in ways nobody has documented yet, and you will need to contain problems fast, often on incomplete information. But every incident should leave behind a standard, a monitor, or a fix — we will judge you on how fast you contain today’s problem, and on how few of them you are still containing three months in. What You’ll Own On-time delivery rate, fulfilment success rate, vehicle utilisation, exception rate and MTTR — the numbers this role is measured on. Fulfilment standards and SOPs that our field and service teams run on. Real-time monitoring and the escalation model — with a documented root cause for every major failure. Turning field problems into prioritised, evidence-backed asks for product and engineering — and following through until the metric moves. What You’ll Need Essential 3–5 years in last-mile delivery, on-demand logistics, ride-hailing, quick commerce or fleet operations. Proven ability to build process, not just run it — you have taken a messy operation, decomposed it, and made it repeatable by others. This matters more to us than years of management. A metric you personally moved , and the story of how. SQL and BI — you pull and cut your own data rather than queuing behind an analyst. Skilled with AI tools — you build your own dashboards, analyses or prototypes instead of waiting on someone else. A track record of driving fixes through teams you don’t manage . Hands-on operating experience in the UAE or wider GCC . Fluent English; based in Abu Dhabi or ready to relocate. Preferred Autonomous vehicle, delivery robot or teleoperation background. Arabic. Team leadership experience. Zero-to-one market launch. What We Offer Competitive package benchmarked to the UAE market. Company-provided AI tool subscriptions. Visa sponsored. Ownership of UAE fulfilment performance in a business building autonomous delivery operations from zero — very few companies in the region are doing this — with a team of 2–3 from day one. This is an early-stage business: frequent problems, fast pace, processes still being written. If that is the environment you do your best work in, this role will give you more of it than most. results.title: Senior Director - Road/Land Freight
results.description: Job Summary: The role will lead and manage P&L, operations, and business growth for trucking fleets and lead teams, win new business, improve network safety, and ensure high on-time delivery rates across the GCC network Key Responsibilities Commercial Accountability Grow revenue and gross margin for the road freight division. Build pricing models and bid strategies for new customer contracts. Secure new business and keep key client accounts happy. Work with sales teams to pitch integrated 3PL solutions. Operations Accountability Oversee daily truckload (TL) and less-than-truckload (LTL) transport performance. Track metrics like on-time delivery, cost per mile, and asset utilization. Manage carrier relationships, partner networks, and subcontractor rates. Drive continuous improvement in transit times and route planning. Team Leadership Lead operations managers, dispatchers, and sales account leads. Set clear performance goals and run regular team reviews. Hire, train, and mentor staff to build a strong workplace culture. Ensure all drivers and staff follow health, safety, and labor laws. Qualifications & Skills Experience: 8+ years in logistics or 3PL, with 4+ years in a senior leadership role. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field. Skills: Strong budget management, contract negotiation, and data analysis. Knowledge: Deep understanding of road freight markets, Hours of Service (HOS) rules, and TMS technology.

results.title: Director of Logistics
results.description: Logistics Director – Saudi Arabia A leading organisation is seeking an experienced Logistics Director to oversee and lead all logistics operations for a major, high-profile development project in Saudi Arabia. This is a senior, site-based leadership position responsible for developing and implementing the overall logistics strategy and ensuring the efficient movement of people, materials, equipment, vehicles, and resources across the project. The role will operate on a hybrid basis between Riyadh and the project site , with a strong site presence required to manage day-to-day logistics activities and coordinate closely with project leadership, contractors, consultants, and key stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Provide strategic leadership and overall direction for all project logistics and site logistics operations . Develop, implement, and continuously improve the project-wide logistics strategy, plans, procedures, and control systems . Oversee the movement, delivery, storage, and distribution of construction materials, plant, equipment, and other resources. Manage site access, traffic management, vehicle movements, laydown areas, storage facilities, delivery scheduling, and logistics compounds . Coordinate logistics requirements across multiple contractors, consultants, suppliers, and project teams to minimise disruption and maximise site efficiency. Establish effective systems for delivery management, material flow, site transportation, and resource allocation . Work closely with construction, engineering, procurement, commercial, HSE, security, and programme teams to ensure logistics activities align with overall project requirements. Monitor logistics performance, identify potential constraints and bottlenecks, and implement proactive solutions to maintain programme progress. Lead the planning and coordination of logistics requirements during different phases of construction and project development. Ensure all logistics activities comply with relevant HSE requirements, Saudi regulations, project standards, and operational procedures . Manage logistics-related risks, developing mitigation strategies and contingency plans where required. Provide regular reporting to senior project leadership on logistics performance, risks, constraints, resource requirements, and upcoming activities. Lead and develop logistics teams, promoting a strong culture of collaboration, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement. Liaise with local authorities, transport providers, suppliers, and other external stakeholders where required. Support the wider project leadership team in resolving complex logistical challenges and ensuring the project remains on programme. Candidate Profile The successful candidate will be a highly experienced Logistics Director / Senior Logistics Manager with a strong background in major construction, infrastructure, urban development, or mega-project environments. Experience managing logistics across large and complex sites, with multiple contractors and significant volumes of people, materials, and equipment, is highly desirable. The individual should demonstrate: Significant senior-level experience in construction and project logistics . Proven experience developing and implementing logistics strategies for large-scale projects. Strong understanding of site logistics, traffic management, material handling, access management, and supply-chain coordination . Excellent leadership and stakeholder-management capabilities. Strong commercial awareness and an ability to manage logistics efficiently within programme and budget constraints. Excellent communication, planning, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. The ability to operate confidently at both strategic and operational levels . Experience working in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC would be advantageous. Location & Benefits This is a hybrid role , with the successful candidate working between Riyadh and the project site in Saudi Arabia . A regular and significant site presence will be required due to the operational nature of the position. When working on site, the package includes: Site allowance payable for time spent on site. Flights between Riyadh and the relevant site location. Hotel accommodation when required. Accommodation and transportation provided in connection with the site assignment. Opportunity to work on a major, high-profile development programme in Saudi Arabia.

results.title: Senior Director: Mobility Planner
results.description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description **Join a Landmark Giga-Project Shaping the Future of Saudi Arabia** Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in planning, designing, and implementing world-class assets and infrastructure that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, cutting-edge technologies, and diverse stakeholders. If you are driven by challenge, motivated by impact, and eager to be part of a legacy project that will influence generations to come, we invite you to consider joining this transformative journey. The Senior Director: Mobility Planner is the ultimate technical, operational, and strategic authority responsible for the end-to-end planning, efficiency, and day-to-day management of the city’s multi-modal mobility network. With a mandate requiring extensive distinguished leadership experience, this executive-level leader oversees the live operations of the entire transportation ecosystem. This includes public transit systems, autonomous shuttle corridors, active mobility trails, parking networks, micro-mobility, and intelligent traffic management systems. Sitting firmly within the O&M division, this role focuses on maximizing network throughput, minimizing congestion, deploying next-generation smart-city mobility technologies, and ensuring safe, seamless, and sustainable journeys for millions of annual residents and visitors. Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Network & Transit Operations (O&M) Direct the daily operations, transit scheduling, and fleet management of all public and private transportation systems, including buses, light rail/monorail, micro-mobility, and autonomous mass transit networks. Oversee the strategic implementation of active mobility frameworks, managing pedestrian corridors, bike networks, and scooter-sharing infrastructure to ensure perfect connectivity between major city hubs and entertainment districts. Serve as the principal authority for high-footfall event transport planning, designing mega-crowd traffic diversion models, park-and-ride strategies, and flexible transit surges to handle peak visitor loads seamlessly. Formulate robust emergency transportation plans, network redundancy routes, and incident-response protocols to guarantee zero-disruption mobility during grid failures or civil emergencies. Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) & Traffic Engineering Direct the operational deployment and tuning of the city's Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), including adaptive traffic signals, automated speed enforcement, and real-time transit information displays. Partner with the digital city operations hub to leverage real-time traffic flow telemetry, predictive AI congestion mapping, and IoT sensor loops to optimize vehicle movements city-wide. Act as the technical authority for the city's smart car parks, integrating automated parking guidance systems (PGS), automated billing, license plate recognition (LPR), and electric vehicle (EV) charging grids with the broader mobility network. Financial Cost Recovery & Asset Integration Translate multi-modal usage logs, public transit ticketing data, and shared mobility fees into automated financial models for corporate finance teams. Provide the Service Charge Director with audited transit-wear metrics to ensure equitable infrastructure cross-charging, charging commercial zones, theme parks, and venues their fair share for the mobility infrastructure feeding their districts. Collaborate with the Asset Lifecycle Planning (LCP) division to map out multi-decade Capital Asset Replacement Plans (CARP) for core mobility infrastructure (e.g., transit fleets, smart charging arrays, signals, and ITS servers). Partner with the SAP-EAMS team to ensure every vehicle, charging dock, traffic sensor, and transit station is assigned a flawless digital ID for data-driven, predictive maintenance scheduling. Stage-Gate Handover & Design Advisory Serve as the primary mobility gatekeeper on the Stage-Gate Handover Committee, auditing traffic impact assessments (TIAs) and multi-modal readiness before newly constructed transit corridors or roads transition into live city operations. Formulate rigorous testing and commissioning verification rules for all transit fleets and smart ITS software networks prior to full operational adoption from builders and vendors. Job Requirements & Qualifications Education & Professional Credentials Bachelor’s Degree in Transportation Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Design, Traffic Engineering, or a highly relevant quantitative technical discipline from an accredited institution. Master’s Degree in Transportation Engineering, Smart Mobility, Urban Planning, or an MBA from a globally recognized institution is highly preferred. Professional Certifications: Active senior professional registration, such as a Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), or certification from the American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) / Institute of Transportation Engineers (ITE). Experience 20+ years of progressive, distinguished leadership experience in multi-modal urban transit planning, large-scale traffic engineering, or smart city mobility operations. At least 8 years in a senior executive or director-level capacity, directly managing multi-disciplinary transport teams and multi-million-dollar mobility operational and capital budgets (OPEX/CAPEX). Proven track record of spearheading the operational setup, network routing, or post-construction integration of giga-scale mass transit networks, autonomous vehicle testbeds, or smart-city traffic frameworks. Deep experience navigating micro-mobility logistics, fleet electrification challenges, demand-side traffic management, and Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 sustainability and smart city targets. Technical & Soft Skills Deep technical command over macro and micro traffic simulation modeling software (e.g., PTV VISSIM, VISUM, Synchro, or equivalent platforms). Executive-level fluency in transport operational technologies, including fleet telematics, automated fare collection (AFC) engines, and SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAMS) integrations. results.title: Operations Manager – Long-Term Rentals
results.description: Location: Dubai, UAE Department: Long-Term Rentals (LTR) Employment Type: Full-time About The Role We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager – Long-Term Rentals to oversee the overall performance of our LTR function. The role will be responsible for coordinating and managing multiple teams, including Sales, Operations, Finance, Customer Service, and other supporting functions , ensuring that all departments work together effectively to achieve business objectives. The ideal candidate will be a strong people leader with excellent commercial and operational understanding, capable of driving performance, improving processes, and ensuring smooth day-to-day functioning of the LTR business. Key Responsibilities Oversee the overall performance and day-to-day functioning of the LTR business. Lead and coordinate teams across Sales, Operations, Finance, Customer Service, and other relevant functions. Set clear KPIs and ensure teams achieve their performance and business targets. Monitor revenue, costs, fleet utilisation, customer satisfaction, and overall operational efficiency. Work closely with department leads to identify issues, improve processes, and ensure smooth cross-functional coordination. Drive customer acquisition, retention, and overall service quality. Monitor financial and operational performance and identify opportunities for cost optimisation and revenue growth. Handle escalations and ensure timely resolution of cross-functional and customer-related issues. Prepare and present regular performance reports and updates to senior management. Lead, motivate, and develop teams while maintaining a strong culture of accountability and performance. Identify opportunities to improve processes, productivity, and overall business efficiency. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations, Management, or a related field. 6–8+ years of relevant experience in operations, car rental, mobility, automotive, fleet management, or a similar industry. Proven experience managing multiple teams or functions. Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills. Strong commercial and analytical mindset with the ability to understand business performance and KPIs. Experience in managing budgets, costs, revenue, and operational performance. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and make effective decisions. UAE experience in car rental, mobility, automotive, or fleet management is highly preferred.

results.title: Director of Operations - Saudi Arabia AOC (GACA)
results.description: Beond is the world's first premium leisure airline, flying an all-lie-flat Airbus fleet, and is standing up new Air Operator Certificates in Bahrain (BCAA) and Saudi Arabia (GACA). We are seeking a Director of Operations for our Saudi Arabia AOC (General Authority of Civil Aviation), based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Director of Operations is appointed by, and reports to, the Accountable Executive, and is responsible for: Exercise operational control and accountability for the conduct of flight operations under the AOC Own the operations manual, ensure ops-specifications compliance and set operational standards Oversee flight dispatch, flight-time limitations and flight-crew standards Serve as the operational interface with GACA for approvals, audits and findings Embed the SMS within operations Requirements This is a required management position under GACAR Part 121.45. The post is full-time and the successful candidate must be acceptable to GACA (the President) based on experience, competence and knowledge, with a full understanding of the GACAR, the operations specifications, applicable airworthiness requirements and the operations manual (GACAR 121.45(e), (g)). Mandatory Hold an Airline Transport Pilot (ATP) certificate (GACAR 121.49(a)(1)) At least 3 years' supervisory/managerial experience within the last 6 years exercising operational control over Part 121-similar operations (GACAR 121.49(a)(2)) At least 3 years' experience within the past 6 years as PIC of a Part 121 aircraft — for a first-time Director of Operations (GACAR 121.49(a)(3)) Full understanding of the GACAR, the operations specifications, applicable airworthiness requirements and the operations manual; must be acceptable to GACA (GACAR 121.45(e), (g)) Desirable Airbus A320/A321 experience Existing GACA regulatory relationships and new-AOC experience Fluent English; Arabic advantageous Benefits A competitive package with relocation support where applicable, and the opportunity to build a premium airline certificate from the ground up as part of a fast-growing multi-AOC group. If you do not receive a response from us within 4 weeks of submitting your application, please consider your application to be unsuccessful due to the high volume of applications we receive.

results.title: Head of Logistics Asset Management - Industrial Real Estate Development & Investments
results.description: Head of Logistics Asset Management & Industrial Development Riyadh, Saudi Arabia We are partnering with a leading industrial real estate investment and development platform that is expanding its presence in Saudi Arabia. The business develops, owns and operates industrial parks, logistics warehouses and built-to-suit facilities, with a long-term ownership strategy focused on creating high-quality logistics assets. As part of its continued growth, the firm is seeking a Head of Logistics to lead its logistics warehouse platform across the Kingdom. Key Responsibilities: Define the logistics warehouse product strategy based on market demand and customer requirements. Partner with development and engineering teams to ensure assets meet commercial and leasing requirements. Monitor market trends, rental levels, supply dynamics and customer demand to support business strategy. Develop relationships with logistics operators, 3PLs, e-commerce businesses, retailers and brokerage networks. Drive leasing activity, occupancy and rental income across the portfolio. Originate and negotiate build-to-suit opportunities and pre-leasing agreements with key occupiers. Lead lease negotiations, including commercial terms, incentives and renewals. Oversee asset performance, including occupancy, NOI, budgets and long-term value creation. Manage external property management and facilities management providers to maintain operational excellence. Build and lead the logistics asset management, leasing and customer development team as the business grows. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business, Finance or a related discipline. 8+ years' experience within logistics or industrial real estate. Strong background across leasing, customer development and asset management. Deep understanding of logistics warehouse products and what drives successful leasing performance. Established network within the Saudi logistics market, including 3PLs, e-commerce operators, retailers and industry stakeholders. Excellent commercial negotiation and relationship management skills. Experience leading or mentoring teams. Fluent in both Arabic and English.
